answers.core: This is further improvement of how missing resources are handled. I suspect this problem is exclusive for mesh libraries. If so, this is more of an issue/bug
answers.workaround: I have to open every problematic resource in vim and manually delete the lines referencing them, which is dangerous, and also a chore if you have mass-deleted prototype textures. In this case, its the mesh library resources.

title: Automatically clean up missing resources (for mesh libraries)
